decision: Change the data/learning experiment before allocating another open-ended continuation. Keep current 124M architecture; optional scaling to 1B is authorized in principle but not recommended until behavior improves.
answer_more_data: Likely yes: current retained lineage has only 247.44M target tokens, about 1.99 per parameter. More of the same web text alone is not established as sufficient. We need a broader token budget plus easier coherent text and explicit context-dependent supervision, tested separately.

sources.finding: 135M model card reports 600B pretraining tokens with a curated mixed corpus. Shows similar size can learn useful language at much larger training scale; not a minimum required token count, and different architecture/tokenizer prevents direct extrapolation.

TinyStories demonstrates coherent restricted-domain stories in very small models using simple synthetic text. Supports easier-language curriculum experiments, not a guarantee of conversation or tools.
Greedy likelihood maximization can cause degeneration. Our penalty experiment reduces repeated phrases but leaves semantic failures; prior nucleus sampling also did not establish usability.

Induction-head work links learning dynamics to context use, with causal evidence in small attention-only models and correlational evidence in larger MLP models. Does not diagnose our model or justify adding layers without measurement.
Small-model-oriented conversation dataset, approximately 460k training rows, Apache-2.0 card. Candidate for later short conversation supervision after length, quality and contamination filtering.

APIGen validates format, execution and semantics. Use this validation approach for our calculate/convert traces. Dataset is gated and includes unrelated APIs; do not import wholesale or treat leaderboard results as evidence for our random-initialized base.

phases.name: Freeze a fresh development test before data work
actions: Keep existing private acceptance suites untouched. Preserve existing 32 public pairs as regression diagnostics, not training templates.

Create 200 new paired fact-flip cases with disjoint entity combinations, paraphrase families, distractors and balanced answer frequencies; stratify prompt lengths 32/128/256/480. Freeze a development/audit split before model testing.

Include exact copying, ownership, latest-state correction, negation, irrelevant distractors and answer-not-present cases. Report both-members-correct, single-member accuracy, margins and free-generation correctness separately.
Include synthetic nonce labels to separate fact recall from context binding; keep these diagnostics out of training.
Validate scorer on known-good and context-ignoring synthetic logits; report length-normalized and summed-logprob results.
phases.reason: Current 32-pair set is small and heavily inspected; more reliable measurement is needed before selecting a new recipe.

phases.name: Admit a bounded training-only pilot corpus
actions: These ratios are an experiment, not a literature-proven optimum. Earlier synthetic-heavy training failed; inspect this mixture rather than assume synthetic data helps.

Use licensed public TinyStories/Cosmopedia subsets as candidates, excluding historical exact and near duplicates; favor complete short documents and plain causal explanations. Reject repetitive, malformed, unsupported and boilerplate passages.

Context prose must vary relations, wording, answer location and distractors, with balanced counterfactual versions generated from independently verified facts. Avoid the existing evaluation templates.

Split by document/source and template family before packing. Screen all historical/private evaluation custody sets using existing admission rules; add historical TRAIN near-dedup, which the previous corpus lacked beyond exact checks.
Human/agent inspect a stratified sample of at least 200 documents and 200 context examples; deterministically validate all generated context answers. Reject a source slice with systematic errors.
Pin dataset revision, license, raw shard hash, record IDs and packed hashes. Count actual tokenizer targets after filtering, not source row counts.
Stream to a bounded staging area; retain compact provenance and packed data, then delete raw staging only after reproducibility verification. No multi-GB download has been started.
phases.disk_budget: 100M uint32 packed tokens roughly 0.4GB; cap raw/cache staging at 5GB and enforce existing free-space guard. Actual metadata/dedup footprint must be measured.

phases.name: Sequential controlled pilot, only after user decision
phases.design: Two sequential 50M-target branches from the same protected endpoint: fresh broad-only control versus proposed mixed curriculum. Same optimizer, LR, batch, token budget and 512 context. Never overlapping weight writers. Control requires a newly admitted corpus: existing fresh source has only about 22M remaining.
phases.estimated_local_training: Combined 100M targets at historical 1400-1600 targets/sec: about 17.4-19.8 hours of training, excluding curation, evaluation and resource pauses. Not an ETA for usable chat.
phases.evaluation: Freeze protocol and thresholds before launch. Measure paired-context behavior and raw completion quality at start and endpoint; use existing resource guards throughout.
phases.proposed_decision_rule: Advance a mixture only if it improves development both-members-correct by at least 10 percentage points versus control, has a positive paired-bootstrap 95% interval on that difference, and improves manual contextual coherence without more than 0.15 nats broad-CE regression. Thresholds are proposed and must be frozen prospectively; private acceptance unchanged.
phases.failure_action: If neither branch materially improves context use, do not extend automatically: inspect corpus samples, training-vs-heldout gaps and a bounded memorize/generalize diagnostic to separate learning failure from transfer failure.

phases.name: Scale tokens only after pilot evidence
phases.proposal: If the mixed curriculum wins, admit up to 1B additional clean target tokens in stages, retaining the 124M model and fixed audit gates. No guarantee that 1B is enough.
phases.estimated_local_training: 1B at 1400-1600 targets/sec is about 7.2-8.3 days of pure training; total calendar time is longer. Re-benchmark if sequence length or hardware changes.
phases.stop_rule: No automatic continuation for CE improvement alone. Require prospective context/coherence progress at each major stage; stop if behavior remains flat.
phases.context_length: Before claiming full 1024-token chat, explicitly train/evaluate upper positions or change the product context contract through reviewed code. Do not silently truncate history.

phases.name: Conversation and executable tool supervision
actions: After base shows transferable coherence/context use, filter short smol-smoltalk-style conversations to the trained context and mix grounded multi-turn corrections, references and follow-ups.

Build calculate/convert episodes using the real broker with actual returned results, argument provenance, missing-argument questions, no-call negatives and dependent follow-ups. Schema checks alone are insufficient.
Use assistant-only loss for role/task instruction examples; retain a language replay slice. Choose token budget after tokenizing admitted data rather than promising a row count.
Separate paraphrase/template families and argument ranges across train/dev; never train on private acceptance or the new frozen audit set.
Assess whole sessions, wrong executions and result-grounded answers. Repetition penalty remains optional and requires tool-JSON validation before changing the default.
Only call the model usable after existing conversation/tool acceptance and practical session gates pass.

not_claimed: No causal proof of missing induction heads or insufficient layers.
No guaranteed token budget or date for usability.
No new training, cloud resource provisioning, dataset download or pretrained substitution performed.
recommendation: Approve a controlled data-mixture pilot next, not another unchanged 75M continuation or a parameter jump. Completion of this plan is the agreed decision boundary.
